shortDescription: Set windows description, owner and organization

options.name: description
options.description: String value to apply to Windows descripton. Specify value of "" to clear the value.

options.name: organization
options.description: String value of organization that the Windows is licensed to. Specify value of "" to clear the value.

options.name: owner
options.description: String value of the persona that the Windows is licensed to. Specify value of "" to clear the value.
